tech.heading: Engineering & Architecture
tech.sub: Cutting-edge technology for high-performance industrial simulations

cards.title: Reactive Engine

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.sub: Everything you need to know about Takt Studio and line simulation

items.q: How accurate are Takt Studio's calculations?
items.a: Calculations are based on standard Industrial Organization Engineering formulas. Accuracy depends on the quality of input data (cycle times, efficiencies). It is an analytical simulation tool for decision-making, not a real-time control system.

items.q: Where is my simulation data stored?
items.a: For privacy and security, your data never leaves your device. It is stored in your browser's local storage (localStorage). If you clear your cache or switch browsers, data will not sync unless you export it manually.

items.q: Can I export my analyses to other formats?
items.a: Yes, Takt Studio lets you export results and the current configuration as PDF for presentations and technical reports, as well as import/export JSON files to share models between users.

items.q: Do I need advanced Lean Manufacturing knowledge?
items.a: Not required, but it helps. The tool is designed to be intuitive, but concepts like 'Bottleneck' or 'Line Balancing' are fundamental to correctly interpret results and make improvement decisions.
